mentions.title: King main and rod bearings marked STDX
mentions.snippet: Search snippet reports a 2024 King main bearing found out of spec on free spread with an expert advising they be sent back, and says a 2025 production run had similar problems. Repeat-run defect claim, not a one-off.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied, and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW builder reports King STDX thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit, across both S85 and S65 blocks. Dimensional defect affecting more than one engine.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Buyer received a King SI main bearing shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted and roughly 1/8" out of size; also reports machining shavings inside rod bearing packaging.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no official King representative has responded and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: king Main&Rod Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Poster reports spinning rod bearings twice in three months on a boosted build running King bearings; another mentions King mains and rods destroyed during initial break-in.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch again returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; still cannot confirm whether King or anyone else has replied.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a wrong/mixed bearing assortment in a sealed King package and says King declined to send a replacement half shell, directing them back to the supplier. Service-handling complaint as much as a QC one.
